standard_prerequisites.name: Left adjoints to a given functor are unique up to unique isomorphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the two left adjoints once the common right adjoint is computed.

standard_prerequisites.name: Pushforward along a composition equals the composition of pushforwards (lemma-pushforward-composition)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the common right adjoint (g composition f)_* = g_* composition f_* that both functors are left adjoint to.

core_obligations: The presheaf pullback f_p is left adjoint to the pushforward f_*, and g_p is left adjoint to g_* (background of the section). By the pushforward-composition lemma, (g composition f)_* = g_* composition f_* (proof lines 2436-2438). Hence both (g composition f)_p and f_p composition g_p are left adjoints to the same functor, so they are canonically isomorphic by uniqueness of adjoints (proof lines 2435-2438). The sheaf-level statement follows by sheafifying the presheaf isomorphism (proof lines 2434-2438).
proof_roadmap: Note both functors are left adjoints to the same pushforward (proof lines 2435-2437).
Conclude by uniqueness of adjoints up to unique isomorphism (proof lines 2435-2438).
difficulty_reason: 5 行、拉回复合：f_p ⊣ f_*、g_p ⊣ g_*，推前复合引理给公共右伴随 (g∘f)_* = g_*∘f_*；伴随唯一性（相差唯一同构）给出 (g∘f)_p ≅ f_p∘g_p。承重两步（公共右伴随、伴随唯一性）都在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。
